messages:
Marta: pushing company OKR draft for exec review. Need a quick alignment thread — focus areas: 1) Q3 runway & Dedicated commit 2) Launch criteria for 'Optimize' initiative 3) customer asks that must be in scope. Link: https://redwood/doc/okr-draft (updated).
Priya: thx. can someone call out the minimal launch criteria for Optimize? I thought we agreed on latency < 300ms p95 and cost < $0.003/token?
Ben: engineering can hit p95 300ms for the canary with 1x dedicated pool, but cost estimate depends on batching config. Need to lock batch window.
Marta: Priya + Ben — is the cost target realistic if we keep prefix caching off for the initial rollout?
Ben: no — caching off pushes cost up ~20%. With prefix caching + quantized model we can meet cost target. Tradeoff: complexity + rollout risk.
Ravi: from CS: top 3 customers (FinCo A, HealthCo B) will require private deployment or strict VPC controls at GA. If we don't commit to that, they won't convert.
Priya: note — Private deployment is a different OKR (Private GA). For Optimize launch, we only need to support routing to Dedicated with IP allowlist. Is that acceptable to FinCo A?
Ravi: FinCo A is strict. IP allowlist + SOC2 cert is minimum; they want on-prem as a follow-on. They'd convert with IP allowlist immediately.
Sam: Exec POV: we need a single crisp ask for sales to sell — minimize branching. Proposal: ship Optimize GA with latency and cost SLOs, Dedicated routing + IP allowlist, and a documented rollback plan. Private/on-prem to be part of Q4 KR.
Marta: agreement check: are we OK to move Private to Q4 and not block Optimize GA?
Ben: engineering + infra can deliver the rollback path and IP allowlist in time. But we'll need a 2-week freeze on model changes before GA to stabilize kernels.
Priya: sounds reasonable. Action items: 1) Priya to update draft with explicit launch criteria 2) Ben to add freeze window and rollout plan 3) Ravi to confirm top customers will accept IP allowlist for now.
Ravi: will confirm with FinCo A tomorrow and post reply.
Sam: one more: if a major customer requires on-prem before GA, we delay GA by one sprint and escalate to me. Otherwise proceed.
ci-bot: doc updated by Priya — https://redwood/doc/okr-draft v1.3
Marta: thanks. let's reconvene tomorrow EOD. :thumbsup:
